name: Sure Bar
author: Andrei Yurik
description: Monthly revenue goal, weekly action, cash flow and one-line expense entry for a self-hosted Sure instance. Unofficial.

schema.label: Sure URL
schema.description: Plain origin, for example http://localhost:3000 or https://sure.example.com

schema.label: Allow plain HTTP to non-local hosts
schema.description: Sends your API key unencrypted. Only for a network you trust.

schema.label: Business tag
schema.description: Transactions with this tag count as business revenue and spending.

schema.label: Count all income as revenue
schema.description: Ignores the business tag. For people who do not separate business money.

schema.label: Default account
schema.description: Part of an account name, used when an entry has no @account.
